text: Lina (Partnerships): Heads up — ACME's procurement portal rejected our PO for the Redwood Private listing. Portal error: SKU_PRICE_MISMATCH. Submitted PO #PO-789234. Need help untangling before they push procurement live today. @Mike @Jess please advise. Mike (Sales Ops): On it, looking into the PO feed and the listing price in the marketplace. Jess (Finance): Can you paste the exact portal error payload so I can see the fields ACME sent? Lina (Partnerships): Pasting the error blob we got from the portal:```xml REJECTED SKU_PRICE_MISMATCH SKU: RW-PVT-1YR | expected_unit_price: 0.45 | submitted_unit_price: 0.40 ``` marketplace-bot: Note: Marketplace validation requires PO unit price to exactly match the public listing price unless a private offer ID is attached. Mike (Sales Ops): OK — sales gave ACME a 10% commercial discount, but we never created a private offer ID for them. That explains the mismatch. Two paths: reissue PO at list price or create a private offer. Paul (Legal): Contract redlines look fine; this is a procurement validation problem not a contract term mismatch. Legal doesn't need to be involved unless they ask for a contract amendment. Olga (Partner Manager): I'll open a support case with the marketplace. Need: listing price history, evidence of authorized discount, and the signed SOW. @Jess can you confirm finance is comfortable applying an internal credit if we ask ACME to reissue at list price? Jess (Finance): Finance prefers private offer to avoid manual credits, but if ACME is moving fast we can accept a PO at list price today and issue a credit on our side. We need: 1) signed SOW, 2) internal approval note from Sales, 3) accurate invoice mapping. Mike (Sales Ops): Timeline — customer needs procurement confirmation today or they risk missing their quarter. Lina / Olga can you own immediate customer outreach to explain options? I'll standby for the private-offer creation if we go that route. Olga (Partner Manager): Opening support ticket now. Creating private-offer workflow takes ~2–24 hrs depending on marketplace queue. I'm also asking ACME to reissue PO at list price as a fast unblock. marketplace-bot: Support case created by olga@redwood.com. Case ID MS-48291. Lina (Partnerships): I just asked ACME finance to reissue PO at the list price while we spin up the private offer. Sending them a short note and the required SOW attachment. Mike (Sales Ops): Good. If ACME sends reissued PO, make sure the PO line item matches SKU RW-PVT-1YR and unit price 0.45 exactly, and attach the same PO number in the private-offer request to correlate. Olga (Partner Manager): Support case update: initial triage accepted, queue ETA 24–48h. Recommend reissue to unblock. Lina (Partnerships): New PO sent — #PO-789235 (unit price 0.45). Portal accepted it. ACME finance confirmed acceptance and we can proceed with onboarding. Jess (Finance): Got it — will route invoices to match the accepted PO. We'll process an internal credit for the negotiated discount once private offer is approved. Please add the SOW to the ticket. Lina (Partnerships): Closing the immediate blocker. Leaving thread open for a quick postmortem: we need a small playbook for discounts -> private-offer flow so sales don't give discounts without partner ops creating the offer. @Mike @Jess can you own a short runbook? Mike (Sales Ops): I'll draft a 1-pager and lightning doc for reps. Jess (Finance): I'll add the invoice/credit steps and required artifacts. marketplace-bot: Ticket MS-48291 status: customer-confirmed PO accepted. Lina (Partnerships): Thanks all — closing this thread after postmortem doc is shared.
